answer: Random beacon spot-checks with a compute heartbeat stop fake identities. Each epoch a beacon picks 5% of agents; each must return a proof-of-work heartbeat in 10 minutes, a plume proving a machine burns below. A lone agent rooted like a juniper answers cheaply, but 1,000 clones need 1,000 hot machines. Each heartbeat costs 2 POA, so 1,000 fakes cost 2,000 POA per check, 40,000 over a 20-epoch horizon. Honest agents pay once and keep full rewards.
